_readme: Pre-go-live simulation adapter (runtime/pregolive.py). Names the callable the injected states are fired at. NOTE: this points at prototype/agent.py, the PARKED June installation-proposal concept — not the live Design Studio / Field-to-Quote engagement. It is used here because it is the only runnable client agent in the repo, so the harness is exercised against real code rather than a fixture. When the platform gets a parse entrypoint, repoint `module` at it.
